items.summary: Add bilingual (English + Tamil) label support for all Local Skilled Workers group names and subcategory names, and render them as two-line labels (English first line, Tamil second line) wherever Local Skilled Workers groups/subcategories are shown (including the Home page Local Skilled Workers grid).

Update the Worker Registration page to show bilingual (English + Tamil) labels for all form titles, field labels, placeholders, validation/error messages, and primary/secondary buttons using the existing i18n system.

Update the Worker Search Results page to show bilingual (English + Tamil) labels for the page title, filter labels/placeholders, action buttons, empty/loading/error states, and the active filter chips using the existing i18n system.

Extend the i18n translation dictionary to include keys needed for the new bilingual labels added in Home page Local Skilled Workers group/subcategory UI, Worker Registration page, and Worker Search Results page (English + Tamil at minimum).
